project_type: Streamlit multi-page demo app (Strands Agents + Amazon Bedrock/AgentCore) with AWS CloudFormation deploy scripts under deploy/ and demos/
build_system: No build step. Python modules under app/; Streamlit runs Home.py. Deploy via bash scripts calling aws cloudformation. Local shell is GNU bash 3.2.57 (macOS) — scripts must be Bash-3.2 compatible.
test_framework: pytest (to be added via app/requirements-dev.txt; app/tests/ to be created). Offline-by-default: tests needing live Bedrock/AWS use @pytest.mark.live and are skipped unless explicitly enabled.
build_command: cd app && python3 -m py_compile Home.py agent_utils.py agentcore_utils.py style.py pages/*.py
verification_instructions: For Python: python3 -m py_compile on changed files (no Streamlit runtime needed; construction of BedrockModel does NOT make network calls). For Bash: bash -n <script> under local Bash 3.2. For CFN: grep-based structural checks only (templates use !Ref/!GetAtt short tags so yaml.safe_load fails; real validation happens at the orchestrator's deploy time). Run the pytest suite offline after app changes. NEVER commit/push/deploy — the orchestrator reviews the full diff then commits/pushes/syncs to EC2.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None. Diagram PNGs under demos/*/diagrams are committed high-res images — do NOT regenerate or touch them.
environment_constraints: Local shell is Bash 3.2 (no associative arrays / declare -A). Do NOT run deploy scripts or any aws command that mutates AWS. Do NOT start a Streamlit server. BedrockModel construction is offline-safe (no network until the model is invoked). claude-haiku-5.x REJECTS the temperature param — never pass it.
contribution_requirements: Work on the main working tree (no worktree). Do NOT commit, push, or deploy. Preserve all existing functionality: chat, judge eval, M4 thread-safe tool-call counter (plain list in session_state), metrics panels, session_state keys, the Diagram/About/Prompts tabs, relative diagram paths (no /Users/erictole or /home/ubuntu absolute paths), part_header styling. Keep runtime requirements.txt minimal; dev/test deps in app/requirements-dev.txt. Never commit a secret.
key_patterns: Config resolves via agentcore_utils._get_config(key): session_state cfg_<KEY> -> env var -> CFN stack outputs. Home.get_cfn_outputs() caches CFN outputs. Model id allow-list is agent_utils._VALID_MODEL_IDS (5 ids). Default FM global.anthropic.claude-haiku-5-5; judge default same. Economy tier intentionally apac.amazon.nova-micro-v1:0. chat_response / chat_response_with_metrics / chat_stream already exist in agent_utils. Pages are big if/elif-by-part files; each part builds its own agent in session_state. st.code("""...""") blocks are DISPLAY strings, not live code — never edit them.
directory_structure: app/ = Streamlit app (Home.py entry, agent_utils.py + agentcore_utils.py helpers, style.py shared CSS/components, pages/ one file per module). deploy/ = EC2/CFN hosting scripts + README. demos/ = per-module infra + example code + committed diagram PNGs (do not touch PNGs). .agents/tasks/ = planning artifacts (this file lives here; NOT inside a commit).
